title: the current state of search engines - music video
summary: A short claymation music video by animator savannahXYZ satirizing how bad web search has become, with SEO spam and ads crowding out real answers. It is comedic rather than analytical.
why: Posted as a light, funny aside in threads about declining search quality and the habit of appending 'reddit' to queries.
